Outbreak Data The most seriously affected countries of the 2014 EBOV outbreak were Guinea, Sierra Leone and Liberia.
Therefore, we mainly use the SEIR model to estimate the cumulative cases of these three countries.

The data needed for the estimation can be obtained from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention[17] which organizes the information provided in all the WHO situation reports[18] that are from March 1, 2014 to the most recent one on February 4, 2015.
The data includes the numbers of reported total cases (confirmed, probable and suspected) and deaths.
